hypothesis: A high DIRECT_EVAL_WEIGHT (0.90) requires highly accurate thresholding. Increasing CALIBRATION_MAX_WORLDS and CALIBRATION_FRACTION will improve calibration fidelity and protect against false positives.
rationale: Direct eval is carrying the performance (weight 0.90). By allocating more training spots (0.15 -> 0.20) and allowing a higher max world count cap (150 -> 200) during threshold calibration, we extract a much more reliable knock threshold. This supports the 0.90 direct eval weight without risking the over-knocking regressions seen at 0.95.
